Every fact block in parts C and C-two of this section cites exactly one physical page of the registered snapshot by anchor, and the statement is paraphrased from that page alone; winter spots, dawn and night driving and the freeway introduction resolve to the first selected page, freeway planning and entering to the second, freeway driving and emergency stops to the third, exiting, emergency basics and the start of blowouts to the fourth, the blowout procedure, lost wheel, brake failure and the start of steering failure to the fifth, steering failure, wheels off pavement, passing conflicts, oncoming vehicles and the start of the stuck accelerator to the sixth, the accelerator procedure, power steering and skids to the seventh, and fire and breakdowns to the eighth.

Confidence: high across the section; every procedure is printed directly on its page. One source-form caution: on the fourth page the emergency-basics bullets interleave with the antilock-brake sentence in the snapshot's text layer, so that paragraph was reassembled in reading order.

Known source hazard: the manual's text layer carries a superseded hidden layer on some pages; every statement here was checked against the visible rendered page, not the hidden text, and no claim rests on hidden lines.
